pin.title: Oden-to Sakana SHINOYA — Susukino Opens in Susukino
pin.description: An announced Susukino izakaya with a branch-published menu of seafood, Niigata dishes, rice pots and hegi soba.
pin.longFormSummary:
An announced Susukino izakaya with a branch-published menu of seafood, Niigata dishes, rice pots and hegi soba.

Employer announcement confirms November 2026 but no firm day. November 30 is an explicitly estimated month-end sorting placeholder, not a confirmed opening. Tabelog November 2 remains to reconcile with operator.
pin.dateConfidenceReasoning: Employer announcement confirms November 2026 but no firm day. November 30 is an explicitly estimated month-end sorting placeholder, not a confirmed opening. Tabelog November 2 remains to reconcile with operator.

menus.note: Exact Sapporo branch native menu prices, not a menu borrowed from another address. Employer confirms November only; November 2 on Tabelog is unconfirmed. Oden cover conflicts: a la carte page ¥680 versus booking-course text ¥580, so no numeric cover or free-oden claim saved. Seats also conflict (98/108), omitted. Two branch-published dish promotions labelled as promotional, not completed premises. Checked operator Gorp page, full Gnavi gallery/menu/course tabs, exact employer listing and Tabelog; completed branch interior and firm day remain gaps. Under-20s not admitted per branch page; heated-tobacco smoking allowed.

rows.title: HOSHINOYA Nara Prison Opens in a Meiji-Era Former Prison
rows.description: Hoshino Resorts opened the 48-suite HOSHINOYA Nara Prison on 25 June 2026 inside the 1908 former Nara Prison, a nationally designated Important Cultural Property, after about seven years of restoration.
rows.longFormSummary:
• Hoshino Resorts opened HOSHINOYA Nara Prison in Nara City on 25 June 2026, calling it Japan's premier heritage resort and its first luxury hotel in a former prison
  • The former Nara Prison was completed in 1908 to a design by Keijiro Yamashita; it is the only one of the 'Five Great Prisons of Meiji' to survive entirely intact, uses the Haviland radial layout and became an Important Cultural Property in 2017
  • Hoshino Resorts worked with the national government and experts for about seven years to restore the site, which also houses the separate Nara Prison Museum
  • All 48 rooms are suites made by joining former cells, the largest being the '11-Cell Deluxe', with exposed hand-laid brickwork and original ceiling mouldings
  • Guests dine on a 'Gastronomy Chronicle' tasting menu tracing French cuisine in Japan in a building converted from former solitary cells, and use a lounge in the old atrium

Notable features

  • 48 all-suite rooms from combined cells in three room types
  • Dining Lounge, courtyard decks and main lounge in the former atrium
  • 'Gastronomy Chronicle' four-course French tasting menu
  • Nara Prison Museum by Hoshino Resorts on the 25-acre site
  • No opening rate used (one listing reports about ¥147,000 per room)
rows.address: 奈良少年刑務所, 国道369号, 北御門町, 雑司町, 奈良市, 奈良県, 630-8102, 日本
rows.dateConfidenceReasoning: Hoshino Resorts' release says it 'celebrates the opening of HOSHINOYA Nara Prison on 25 June 2026'.
